Name: Grapes All Year Round
Author: gzhynko
Description:
A content pack for Crop Growth Adjustments that allows grape vines to grow all year round, but produce grapes only in fall.

[i]Note: [/i]If you want a similar mod, but with grape vines producing all year round as well, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4231]this one[/url] instead.


[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip its folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Download and extract [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18914]Crop Growth Adjustments[/url].

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 3.18 and higher (the latest version is recommended).
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 and higher.
[/list]

Grapes All Year Round is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/GrapesAllYearRound]open-source[/url]﻿ and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
